text: Snowflake CLI lets developers create, manage, update, and view apps across Streamlit, Native Apps, Snowpark Container Services, and Snowpark
quote: With Snowflake CLI, developers can create, manage, update, and view apps running on Snowflake across workloads such as Streamlit in Snowflake, the Snowflake Native App Framework, Snowpark Container Services, and Snowpark.

text: dbt Projects on Snowflake supports the full dbt lifecycle: develop, deploy, orchestrate, and observe transformations inside Snowflake
quote: dbt Projects on Snowflake brings the full dbt lifecycle into Snowflake: develop, deploy, orchestrate, and observe your transformations in the same place your data already lives.

text: Snowflake provides managed dbt Core and dbt Fusion runtimes, so there is no dbt infrastructure to manage
quote: No infrastructure to manage: Snowflake provides managed dbt Core and dbt Fusion runtimes.

text: Documented migration path from an existing dbt Core project to dbt Projects on Snowflake
quote: Migrating an existing dbt Core project? See the Migrate from dbt Core to dbt Projects on Snowflake.

text: Virtual warehouses can be started, stopped, and resized at any time, even while running

text: Virtual warehouses are user-managed, so users directly control credit consumption
quote: Virtual warehouses consume credits as they execute queries, load data and perform other DML operations. Virtual Warehouses are user-managed, which means you can directly control credit consumption of these resources.

text: Resource monitors track warehouse credit usage and can suspend or disable warehouses when they reach a credit limit
quote: You can use a resource monitor to monitor credit usage by virtual warehouses ... You can also set up a resource monitor to suspend a standard virtual warehouse or disable an Adaptive Warehouse when it reaches a credit limit.

text: Anomaly monitors detect cost anomalies, with notification integrations for cost anomaly alerts
quote: Anomaly monitors for cost anomalies (Preview)

text: Per-user quotas are generally available

text: Consumption-based pricing model
quote: We keep pricing simple with a consumption-based pricing model.

text: Time Travel lets you access historical data that was changed or deleted, at any point within a defined period

text: Restore deleted objects, either individual tables or all objects inside a container object

text: Stream objects record DML changes (inserts, updates, deletes) on tables, plus change metadata, so actions can be taken on the changed data
quote: A stream object records data manipulation language (DML) changes made to tables, including inserts (including COPY INTO), updates, and deletes, as well as metadata about each change, so that actions can be taken using the changed data.

quote: CREATE OR ALTER DYNAMIC TABLE (General availability)

text: Role-based access control assigns privileges to roles, which are assigned to users
quote: Role-based Access Control (RBAC): Access privileges are assigned to roles, which are in turn assigned to users.

text: Cloning a database or schema carries over granted privileges on the clones of its child objects
quote: If the source object is a database or schema, the clone inherits all granted privileges on the clones of all child objects contained in the source object

text: Secure Data Sharing shares selected database objects with other Snowflake accounts without copying or transferring data
quote: Secure Data Sharing lets you share selected objects in a database in your account with other Snowflake accounts. ... no actual data is copied or transferred between accounts.

text: Snowflake Notebooks offer an interactive, cell-based environment in Snowsight for Python, SQL, and Markdown

quote: Notebooks in Workspaces is the next generation of Snowflake Notebooks, providing Jupyter compatibility and full integration with Workspaces.
